description: This file defines the ZoomVideoService class, which manages OAuth authentication and credential handling for Zoom integration within a conferencing module. It includes methods for generating auth URLs, connecting to Zoom, and managing credentials in repositories.

classes.name: ZoomVideoService
classes.description: Service class for handling Zoom OAuth authentication, token exchange, and credential management.

methods.name: getZoomAppKeys
methods.description: Retrieves Zoom app credentials (client_id and client_secret) from the apps repository.

methods.name: generateZoomAuthUrl
methods.description: Generates the OAuth authorization URL for Zoom with the provided state parameter.

methods.name: connectZoomApp
methods.description: Handles the OAuth callback, exchanges code for tokens, manages credential storage, and returns redirect URL.
